body.x: The Seoul Business Agency (SBA, President and CEO Hyunwoo Kim) announced on the 29th that it produced 17 CES 2026 Innovation Award–winning companies, including one Best of Innovation winner.

The CES Innovation Awards are presented in conjunction with CES, the world’s largest technology exhibition organized by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA). The awards recognize the most outstanding products and services through a comprehensive evaluation of innovation, technological excellence, and market potential. Winning a CES Innovation Award is a key indicator of global competitiveness.

The Seoul Business Agency has worked with 18 startup support organizations representing Seoul’s startup ecosystem to establish and operate the CES 2026 Seoul Pavilion and to provide consulting support for CES Innovation Award applications. As a result, SBA produced 17 CES 2026 Innovation Award Honorees and one Best of Innovation winner, achieving a milestone that showcased Seoul startups’ technological strength and innovation on the global stage.

Among the 17 CES 2026 Innovation Award winners, STUDIO LAB received the CES Best of Innovation Award, which goes to only about 30 companies worldwide each year, including major conglomerates. This marks STUDIO LAB’s second Best of Innovation win following CES 2024. Meanwhile, Otiton Medical, which has participated in CES under the Seoul Pavilion in both 2025 and 2026, once again earned a CES Innovation Award, achieving back-to-back wins. These results underscore how the Seoul Pavilion support program drives the sustainable growth of participating companies.

Sunghoon Kang, CEO of STUDIO LAB and a two-time Best of Innovation winner, pointed to SBA’s Innovation Award consulting as a key factor behind the achievement. Kang said, “I sincerely thank SBA for its generous, long-term support, including CES Innovation Award consulting, which enabled STUDIO LAB to pursue distinctive AI and robotics R&D. We will continue to create results through ongoing collaboration.” He added, “As AI models and robotics technologies advance rapidly, STUDIO LAB continues research to apply these innovations meaningfully to everyday life. We are delighted that the global market has recognized our work, and receiving the Best of Innovation Award for two years is a great honor. We will keep listening closely to customers so that companies and brands worldwide can gain tangible benefits through our technology.”

Jayden Kim, CEO of Otiton Medical, said, “Winning the CES Innovation Award reflects the combination of Otiton Medical’s technology and systematic consulting.” He added, “Market analysis and product positioning by professional consultants helped us establish our identity, which I believe led to our consecutive wins,” emphasizing the effectiveness of the CES Innovation Award consulting.

body.x: SBA’s CES Innovation Award consulting program pairs startups one-on-one with experts, with dedicated consultants providing close support from application drafting through submission. The program offers professional editing and English proofreading of applications and submission materials. It helps companies prepare and refine promotional assets, such as English-language websites and product videos, to meet global evaluation standards. SBA provides multiple rounds of feedback and ongoing Q&A support through the deadline, and guides companies through every step of the application process so they can craft product strategies aligned with judging criteria and submit highly polished applications.

The consultants’ capabilities also stand out. Through a cross-check system that brings together investment-focused accelerators, technical reviewers, and native English editors, the program delivers intensive one-on-one consulting to maximize engineering, design, and innovation—the core evaluation criteria for the awards.

In addition, engineering PhDs from leading U.S. research institutes analyze each company’s R&D capabilities to identify competitive strengths. At the same time, experts with experience as venture CEOs and KOSDAQ listing committee members assess global business appeal. Native English-speaking engineers from top overseas universities and global startup founders further enhance the quantitative and qualitative quality of applications with storytelling expertise, forming the core strategy of the program.
On the back of this structured support, the SBA has provided consulting services to about 250 companies over the past three years, resulting in 56 Innovation Award winners.

SBA continues support beyond award recognition through follow-up programs and management. In particular, SBA operates a CES Innovation Award Community for award-winning companies, providing ongoing post-support programs to foster inter-company collaboration. STUDIO LAB and Otiton Medical actively participate in this community.

The CES Innovation Award Community is a networking council formed around Innovation Award winners among Seoul Pavilion–supported companies, launched in September to promote information sharing and joint commercialization opportunities.

Within the community, companies voluntarily engage in small-scale team-building activities, while the SBA supports the formation and operation of these groups and provides grants to encourage collaborative outcomes. SBA also operates online communication channels to collect feedback and share information about support programs, increasing accessibility for participating companies. At the same time, SBA strengthens practical collaboration and results by linking internal and external resources through customized growth support programs that back companies’ post-CES development.

Through these efforts, SBA goes beyond simple exhibition support and builds a sustained support system that strengthens companies’ overseas expansion capabilities even after CES. By expanding cooperation networks with universities, public institutions, and private companies across Seoul, SBA continues to lay a solid foundation for Seoul’s startup ecosystem that supports companies throughout their entire growth cycle.

Hyunwoo Kim, President and CEO of the Seoul Business Agency, said, “I am proud of the Seoul startups that achieve outstanding results at CES every year.” He added, “By producing numerous Innovation Award winners annually, Seoul continues to prove the innovation and potential of its startup ecosystem in the global market. SBA will keep leveraging diverse support programs and close collaboration across public and private networks in Seoul to build an advanced, Seoul-style startup ecosystem that drives stronger global expansion outcomes.”
